audit.why: The shape is right and matches the 52.44% headline: Cassiopeia owns the lane from the first poison tick, Malphite gets one real window at 6, and she takes it back at two items. Both layers agree on the rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Miasma was called 'matchup-defining' with no cooldown attached, so there was no spike to play around.
audit.why: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 — by far the longest cooldown in her laning kit and the only thing that stops Unstoppable Force. That 24s window, not a level, is Malphite's engage spike. Petrifying Gaze is 120s at rank 1 and is the second gate.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, tldr and dosFull[0].d now carry the 24s and 120s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer said 'Her Q grounds'. It does not — Noxious Blast is a delayed poison zone. Miasma (W) is the grounding ability. Separately, Petrifying Gaze was described only as a 'face-stun' with the actual rule never stated.
audit.why: Riot's text: Miasma slows, grounds and lightly damages, and grounded enemies cannot use movement abilities; Noxious Blast only poisons and grants her move speed. And Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her — anyone with their back turned is merely slowed. That is a live lever for Malphite: disengaging with your back to her downgrades her 120s ultimate to a slow.
audit.corrected: Fixed whys[1] to name Miasma as the ground, and added the facing rule to breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer referred to Cassiopeia as 'he' and 'his' in tldr, winCon, the Do bodies and the Don't titles.
audit.why: Cassiopeia is female; a page that gets the pronoun wrong reads as machine-written and undermines the rest of the advice.
audit.corrected: Corrected the pronouns in tldr, winCon, dontsFull[0].t and dosFull[1].d while rewriting them.

edits.before: Her Q grounds and her empowered Twin Fang chunks you the moment she lands poison, and you still have no answer at 2 points.
edits.after: Miasma (W) is what grounds you, not her Q — and empowered Twin Fang chunks you the moment poison lands, with no answer at 2 points.

edits.after: She kites you out — survive, then Q-poke her down and hold R for the game-winning engage. Malphite wins the 24s Miasma window.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Cassiopeia Miasma: 24s at rank 1 — it grounds, and grounded means your R cannot leave the ground. Her Q does not ground. - Twin Fang: 0.75s, but only big on a poisoned target. - Petrifying Gaze: 120s, and it stuns only enemies facing her.

edits.before: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Miasma grounds you — movement abilities are dead inside it. 24s at rank 1, so engage once she has spent it.

edits.before: Q Cassiopeia on his last-hits (speed steal in, slow out), E his attack speed if he answers, and reset behind the passive shield.
edits.after: Q her last-hits (speed steal in, slow out), E her attack speed if she answers, and turn your back on Petrifying Gaze — facing her stuns.

notes: 'Her Q grounds' in whys[1] was a real ability error — grounding is Miasma (W), exactly the Cassiopeia case in the calibration list. The full layer also called Cassiopeia 'he' throughout; I corrected it in the fields I rewrote, but breakdown.trading, ahead, loading and several report[] entries still use male pronouns for her and were outside what I edited. The kit file flags Malphite's Q and E as 'grounding' — Riot's descriptions say slow and attack-speed slow only — so I never claimed Malphite grounds her.
